campaign_listing_description: Create and discover public campaigns that describe which environmental phenomena should be measured in a specific area.
create_campaign_description: Describe the goal, requirements, phenomena, and area for a public measurement campaign.
no_campaigns_text: Try changing the filters or create the first campaign.
campaign_map_description: Browse the currently visible campaigns by their measurement area.
title: Title
discussion_url_help: Optional link to a Discourse topic or another external discussion space.
measurement_requirements_description: These targets define when an area cell is considered covered by existing openSenseMap measurements.
grid_size_help: A 6 x 6 grid is a good default. Larger grids are more detailed but need more measurements.
campaign_area_description: Draw a polygon by clicking on the map, or upload/paste a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with one Polygon feature.
draw_area_hint: Click at least three points on the map to create a polygon.
map_loading_geojson_fallback: The interactive map editor is still loading. You can paste GeoJSON here and submit the campaign.
bookmark_campaign_description: Save this campaign to find it again later. Bookmarking does not count as participation.
campaign_discussion_description: Use the linked discussion space for questions, coordination, and longer conversations.
organizer_updates_description: Short campaign notices from the organizer.
organizer_update_placeholder: Share a short update, request, or change of plan for this campaign.
no_organizer_updates: No organizer updates have been posted yet.
contributing_devices_description: Public devices with matching sensors and measurements in this campaign area.
no_contributing_devices: No matching public devices have contributed measurements yet.
measurements_note_text: Formal participation is not required. A future slice can evaluate matching measurements from devices in this area and time range.
